"GAME DEVELOPMENT PROMPT 01: THE LITTLE GHOST CAT

Create a complete, playable, third-person 3D adventure game starring the exact blue ghost cat from the uploaded reference image. The game takes place inside a beautiful, mysterious old mansion. The cat is a small supernatural creature exploring the mansion to recover its forgotten memories and discover why it is there.

CORE REQUIREMENTS:
- Fully 3D real-time environment, not a 2D game or static scene.
- Third-person camera following the cat smoothly, with freely adjustable camera rotation.
- Responsive keyboard and mobile touchscreen controls.
- Walking, running, jumping, turning, idle animations, interacting, and gentle floating.
- Accurate cat character proportions, translucent light-blue body, long ears, blue and amber heterochromatic eyes, and flowing ghost tail. Preserve the uploaded reference design.
- A detailed, explorable mansion with a foyer, living room, library, dining room, kitchen, bedrooms, corridors, attic, basement, and garden.
- Interactive doors, furniture, books, photographs, toys, objects, drawers, and environmental details.
- Exploration, collectible memory fragments, environmental puzzles, hidden passages, keys, and locked rooms.
- A gentle supernatural atmosphere with warm lighting, moonlight, dust particles, rain, and emotional music. No horror, gore, jump scares, or combat.
- Implement save/load, checkpoints, settings, pause menu, and a working objective system.
- Build functional gameplay, not just a visual mockup. Every major interaction must work.

STORY PREMISE:
The little ghost cat awakens in an unfamiliar old mansion with no memory of its past. It explores the building, discovers traces of a forgotten life, and collects memories hidden in ordinary objects. Each recovered memory reveals a new piece of its story. Its ultimate goal is to understand its past and find a way out of the mansion.

ART DIRECTION:
High-quality stylized 3D animation-film aesthetic, charming character animation, expressive eyes, beautiful environmental storytelling, detailed materials, soft shadows, warm and cool lighting contrast, and carefully composed camera shots. Avoid photorealism and cheap low-poly visuals.

DEVELOPMENT PRIORITIES:
1. Create a fully playable 3D prototype.
2. Implement the cat model and movement system.
3. Implement camera and collision systems.
4. Build the explorable mansion.
5. Implement interactions and puzzles.
6. Implement memory collection and story progression.
7. Add sound, music, UI, saving, and polish.

TECHNICAL QUALITY:
Use clean modular architecture, stable physics, optimized 3D assets, reliable collision detection, persistent progress, and responsive controls. Test all gameplay systems. Fix runtime errors, broken interactions, missing assets, and camera problems before declaring completion.

IMPORTANT: Do not replace the cat with a generic animal. Do not change its distinctive appearance. Do not turn the game into a horror game. Prioritize a complete playable experience over decorative mockups. If a feature is too large to complete at once, implement a working version first and extend it later.

Attachments:

- ![1793468112405.jpg](https://omgithub.com/api/issue-attachments/b96795f5-0da5-4d50-94a7-a79206e81489)
- ![1793468114138.jpg](https://omgithub.com/api/issue-attachments/c6d8e5cd-d7ac-4faf-a3da-8f6fa8d86375)
- ![1793468119657.jpg](https://omgithub.com/api/issue-attachments/18eb9f41-b154-4b5e-8172-c49af24dee46)
"
